verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document grouping or filtering by high-cardinality fields such as user ID or request ID without pre-aggregation or index definition. Loki is described as indexing only label metadata, and LogQL is described as filtering with labels and operators. Neither claim addresses ad-hoc high-cardinality group-by. The generic ad-hoc query and drilldown claims are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first
